items.summary:
Leighton Meester has fallen more in love with Adam Brody as the years have gone by.

“It’s amazing that when you marry someone, you’re so, so, so in love and you think of the future and you fantasize and talk about it and plan,” Meester, 40, told Elle in a profile published Wednesday, November 18. “Then you find yourself in the future, and somehow you’re even more in love.”

She continued, “The intimacy and the love and the depth of the relationship is that much more, and you’re like, ‘I never thought that I could love you more.’ Life is filled with ups and downs and going through everything together, you get closer and it’s kind of hard to believe that’s possible.”

Meester and Brody, 46, have been married since February 2014 , going on to welcome two children together in August 2015 and October 2020, respectively.

Adam Brody Is So in Love With Leighton Meester in Adorable New Interview 

“I know that I felt this way [about love] when I met him, but even more so now, my life is better living it with him,” the Guarding Stars actress gushed to the outlet. “And to be loved and understood by somebody, especially when you think the world of them, it’s kind of surreal and it’s the best thing in the world.”

Meester and the Nobody Wants This leading man especially clung to each other after losing their house in the devastating Los Angeles wildfires in January 2025.

items.title: Dad Kills Wife, 3 Kids as Young Child Begs for Their Life in Murder-Suicide
items.summary:
Authorities in Florida said a father fatally shot his wife and their three young children before taking his own life in a horrific murder-suicide at their home.

Hillsborough County Sheriff Chad Chronister said during a news conference on Thursday, November 19, that authorities learned about the tragedy earlier that day around 3:30 p.m. when Hillsborough County dispatchers received a 911 call with no one responding on the line.

Dispatchers said they heard a man say, “Sorry, buddy,” before a gunshot was heard. A small child was also heard begging for their life in the background of the call.

Deputies arrived at the home in Plant City, Florida, 10 minutes later and spotted a lifeless child on the floor inside, so they kicked down the door to enter the home. The officers then discovered the man had “executed” his wife and their three children before dying by suicide.

Florida Mother Allegedly Killed Her 2 Children Then Died by Suicide 

Investigators have not shared who made the initial 911 call from inside the home, and deputies are still working to determine what events led up to the killings. Chronister added that there is no clear motive as of time of publication.

While the names of the deceased have not yet been publicly revealed, Chronister said that the children were 1, 3 and 5 years old.

Chronister said that the family had moved into the home about one year before the murder-sucide. The family had no history of reported domestic disputes, and deputies had never responded to any calls for service at the home.

The sheriff also took a moment to urge anyone…

items.title: Boy, 14, Allegedly Killed Great-Aunt Who Had Been 'Afraid' of Him
items.summary:
A 14-year-old Massachusetts boy is accused of fatally assaulting his great-aunt, who was found dead inside her kitchen after police were told she had fallen and was bleeding.

Brayden Lee , of Lowell, is charged with murder and assault and battery in connection with the death of Sheila Ingebritson , according to the Middlesex County District Attorney’s Office .

Authorities arrested Lee in Lowell on Thursday, November 19, more than three months after he allegedly killed Ingebritson, 69, the district attorney’s office announced in a news release.

Lee is being charged as an adult, as “all juveniles aged 14 and older charged with murder are automatically treated as adults” in Massachusetts, according to the state .

New Jersey Teen Accused of Killing Grandma by Stabbing Her in Her Face 

The charges against the teen stem from August 11, when police were called to a report about a woman who was allegedly bleeding after falling in her Lowell home, according to prosecutors.

Officers found Ingebritson dead in the kitchen with multiple injuries subsequently documented by a medical examiner, including a broken jaw, broken neck bone and skull fracture, prosecutors said.

Ingebritson lived with Lee and had custody of him, according to investigators. She was allegedly fearful of him.

“On several occasions the victim had allegedly expressed that she was afraid of the defendant and that he was volatile,” the district attorney’s office said.

Investigators learned Lee and Ingebritson had argued the day she died, based on a review of photo records and surveillance footage from…

During an exclusive interview with Us at a PaleyLive event for the TV drama on Thursday, November 19, Snow, 40, weighed in on what kind of epic death scene she would want for her character, Sophie, saying, “I’d want to square off against Margo and see if I killed or got killed myself or we had to choose each other. Snow clarified that the options were a long way off. 

“I hope that we last for [at least] eight seasons and that’s going to be the last scene where we have to either kill each other or it’s kind of an epic [scene] with the guns drawn. Like a duel?” she suggested. “[Like] Thelma and Louise. We could just go off into the sunset in a car — and wear wigs. We don’t want that, but I think that would be an epic death scene.”

'The Hunting Wives': Burning Questions Answered Ahead of Possible Season 2 

After Us suggested an ending where Margo ( Malin Åkerman ) and Sophie found their way back to each other after Maple Brook’s constant death and destruction came to an end, Snow added, “Exactly. That’s what I want too.”

items.title: Principal Arrested for Not Reporting Teacher Who Photographed Up Girl's Skirt
